ticket.title: Bulk action to mark selected invoices as paid
ticket.description: Accountants currently mark invoices as paid one by one after each bank import, which is slow. Add a bulk action in the invoice list: selecting one or more invoices via checkboxes shows a Mark as paid button, which opens a confirmation dialog showing the number of invoices to be changed, with the paid date defaulting to today and already paid invoices skipped.

feature.userNeed: Accountants need to mark many invoices as paid at once after each bank import instead of one by one, because the current process takes too long.
feature.proposedBehavior: In the invoice list, each invoice has a checkbox so several can be selected. When at least one invoice is selected, a Mark as paid button appears. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog showing how many invoices will be changed. The paid date defaults to today. Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoice list shows a checkbox for each invoice that can be selected.
The Mark as paid button appears when at least one invoice is selected.
Clicking Mark as paid opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed.
The paid date is set to today's date by default.
Invoices that are already paid are not changed when the bulk action is confirmed.

missingInformation.question: Is the accountant role the only user group that needs this, or should other roles have access as well?
Should the paid date be editable in the confirmation dialog, or is today's date always used?
Should the bulk action also be available from other screens, or only from the invoice list?
